mappedParameters.sheet: Source sheet default 1.6 mm preserved, adjustable 1.6–2.4 mm
mappedParameters.fit: Source thickness surplus ~.100012 mm informs proposed .15 mm TOTAL allowance (.1–.3), not physically calibrated
mappedParameters.radialSocketLength: Measured 4.5 mm retained in all twelve real sockets; reconstructed tongue is 4.5 minus fit mm
mappedParameters.tabHeight: New .4–.6 mm bed-level runners; source .21/.22 mm low planes recorded but not copied as universal print dimensions
mappedParameters.shape: Straight, sine-full and faceted slats keep identical 8 mm end shoulders and fixed mating datums

designDecisions: Eight original parts: a socketed circular floor, open annular collar and six outward-flared vertical radial slats
Lower socket radius 18–22 mm; upper radius adds 8–12 mm flare; upper shoulders at 32–44 mm
Tangential socket width equals sheet plus total allowance; radial socket length stays 4.5 mm
Two end tongues on each slat locate into closed sockets; shoulders carry the collar, twelve adhesive seats retain it
No positive snap lock or press-fit force claim. Glue is required for stable dry desk use; open slats are not a sealed vessel
Original three-row divided carrier uses four accessible bed-level runners per part, 32 in total, away from functional tongues and sockets
Image or exact convex imported STL engraves the floor center only, within 6.5 mm radial keep-in; minimum backing 1 mm
No raw source asset redistributed, no convex hull substitution, no repair or physical-print claim
